row.notes: Whole body read. props = {package base, PkgObj}. Looks up key (hash at key+0) in the PkgObj (inline 12-byte key table when count word >= 0x1000000, else Vm_Find_PkgObjectKey_Thunk). If the value word has the high bit set it is a sub-object offset (base + (v & 0x7fffff), Vm_PkgObj_ResolveRootOffset) and key 0x425ed3ca (string 0x145614ae4) is looked up inside it; otherwise the value of the key itself is used. A value word > 0xffffff selects an 8-byte pointer from the object's pointer table (obj + *obj, slot index = v >> 24), anything else yields the default 0x14612bf70. Writes *out; returns 3 when the key is missing or the pointer is NULL, else 0. Context from caller: the returned pointer is used as a type descriptor (vt+8 creates an instance with the UiSystem allocator, vt+0x10 gives a type id that 0x144212290 compares between keys 0x1bcf29d8 and 0x32608848); callers are control init functions 0x144212290, 0x14421b2a0 (key 0xd872e2a5) and 0x144233030 (key 0xbde64e3e).
